verdict.rationale: Skyfire issues per-agent API keys scoped to a single Buyer or Seller agent, and tokens are further limited by committed dollar amounts, expiry windows, and identity/verification levels, giving clear least-privilege scoping; a live probe confirms the API actually rejects unauthenticated/invalid-key requests. Missing for 10: independent third-party audit of scope enforcement and finer-grained permission scopes beyond buyer/seller/amount/expiry.
